claim_text: On September 17, 2025, a grand jury in the District of Minnesota returned an indictment in United States v. Christopher Adesoji Falade and Emmanuel Oluwademilade Falade, No. 0:25-cr-00351 (ECF 1), charging both defendants with Counts 1–4, wire fraud, 18 U.S.C. § 1343. Each count is an alleged interstate email: Count 1, on or about April 4, 2025, to both defendants, subject Fwd: Service Verification Forms; Count 2, on or about March 31, 2025, to Christopher Falade attaching purported patient day sheet CCF_000271.pdf; Count 3, on or about March 31, 2025, to Christopher Falade attaching CCF_000272.pdf; Count 4, on or about May 22, 2025, from Emmanuel Falade to HealthPartners, subject Anna records HSS records. These are charging allegations, not adjudicated facts.
